summary_1line: Dhritarashtra laments his sons’ deaths as Sanjaya recounts a brutal battle where Pandavas concentrate attacks, Bhima devastates elephants, and carnage spreads across the field.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima charges into the Kaurava elephant division, arrows flying as wounded elephants with severed trunks crash to the blood-soaked earth.
The battlefield becomes a river of blood flowing among shattered chariots, broken banners, and fallen warriors glittering with gold ornaments.
Drona stands with bow drawn as terrified Srinjaya warriors fall around him, the field echoing with cries and groans.
